rules.trigger: RTB copy of rent review notice not served within 7 days
rules.current_consequence: RTB states the rent review notice is invalid.
rules.source: RTB — Setting and reviewing private rents from 1 March 2026

rules.current_consequence: The RTB identifies failure to provide a rent review notice correctly as an enforceable rental-law breach. From 14 September 2026, fixed payment notices can apply to this breach.
rules.source: RTB — Important changes to rental law from 14 September 2026

rules.current_consequence: The RTB dispute-resolution route may be relevant; enforcement and dispute resolution are separate processes.
rules.source: RTB — Should I report a landlord or bring a dispute?

guardrail: Do not infer that every missed deadline has the same consequence. The engine must use the specific legal/procedural rule attached to the triggering event.
